orbit.texts.native_library_integrity_che: Orbit - Native Library Integrity Check Failed
Orbit couldn't verify that its JNI bridge native library was genuine, so it was not loaded.
Orbit couldn't verify that all of the required Ultralight native libraries were genuine, so they weren't not loaded.
This can happen if the libraries were modified or corrupted in some way, or if an internet connection was not available to verify them.
Check your internet connection and relaunch the game. If it keeps happening, delete Orbit and the contents of its folder then download and install a fresh copy of the mod.

If you know and understand the modifications that were made to the libraries, you can disable the integrity check by adding the following property to your JVM arguments: -Dorbit.disableIntegrityCheck=true
If none of the above works, please open a report on Orbit's issue tracker on GitHub.
